messages:
nina: Quick sanity run for wolverine-45b quant profiles across h100/a100 in us-west, eu-central, ap-south. TL;DR below — looking for kernel recs and any obvious quality regressions.

raj: Nice, can you include the commit + config? Also which eval set you used for quality deltas?

nina: commit: 3f2a7b9 (quant-configs/2026-03). Eval: 10k in-house QA prompts (mixed length, 8-120 toks). Batch target=32 for throughput runs, realtime p50 runs single-request path.

mike: paste the numbers? small table is fine.

nina: pasted results snapshot:
```
Region | GPU  | Profile | p50(ms) | p95(ms) | toks/s | quality delta (ppl)
US-WEST| H100 | FP16    | 46      | 130     | 3200   | baseline
US-WEST| H100 | INT8    | 31      | 95      | 4800   | +1.6% ppl
US-WEST| H100 | FP8     | 34      | 98      | 4500   | +0.9% ppl
EU-CENT | A100| FP16    | 62      | 165     | 2500   | baseline
EU-CENT | A100| FP8     | 40      | 110     | 3800   | +2.9% ppl
AP-SOUTH| H100 | FP8     | 39      | 115     | 3900   | +3.8% ppl (small reg)
AP-SOUTH| A100 | INT8    | 48      | 140     | 2700   | +4.5% ppl (noticeable)
```
nina: Notes: kernel selection used current release kernels from runtime v1.8; H100 FP8 ran fused_attention_v2 + fused_gemm; A100 FP8 used fallback generic_gemm with patched cuBLAS.

mike: Interesting — H100 INT8 best perf and smallest quality hit. AP-SOUTH shows larger quality hit for fp8 on H100, curious. Did you run warmup cache first?

nina: yes 200 warmup reqs before measuring. Same seed/inputs across regions. I suspect tokenizer differences (we're using region-local tokenizer endpoints) — I'll rerun with centralized tokenizer to rule that out.

raj: Kernel recs: on H100 continue using fused_attention_v2 for FP8/INT8. For A100, FP8 needs updated kernel (we saw generic_gemm perf regression); consider enabling tensorcore_fallback for attention on A100 (experiment flagged).

mike: Capacity sizing rough calc — example: avg request = 65 toks. For 1k RPS -> 65k toks/s. Using measured toks/s: H100 INT8=4800 => naive GPUs = ceil(65000/4800)=14. H100 FP8=4500 => ~15. With continuous batching and prefix cache expect ~20-30% improvement -> plan 10-12 GPUs with margin.

eva: From product side: target 99th latency below 250ms for interactive tier. Which profile gets us closest in eu-central?

mike: EU-CENT A100 FP8 p95=110ms, so that meets 250ms easily. But quality delta +2.9% ppl — need eval on our QA acceptance threshold. If >2% we probably can't ship to interactive without canary.

nina: I ran a quick QA accept check: INT8 on H100 stays within threshold (<1.5% ppl). FP8 on A100/AP-SOUTH crosses 2.5-4% on some prompt subsets (code and math).

perf-bot: Run 1765439999-1 completed. Artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/wolverine/1765439999/raw.tar.gz (includes traces + kernel logs)

raj: Action items: 1) nina rerun centralized tokenizer + attach diffed outputs on the math & code slices. 2) infra: try enabling tensorcore_fallback on A100 FP8 in a test fleet. 3) mike: prepare capacity calc spreadsheet with batching assumptions for planning.

nina: Will do. Re-running centralized tokenizer now, will post quick diff in this thread in ~30m. :coffee:

mike: If AP-SOUTH FP8 reg persists, suggestion: route production AP-SOUTH requests to H100 INT8 by policy, or fallback to FP16 on surge.

eva: Agreed — prefer conservative rollout until we have per-slice evals.

nina: quick follow-up (re-run start): centralized tokenizer run shows smaller quality deltas: AP-SOUTH H100 FP8 reduced to +1.8% ppl on code slice. Math still +3.1%. Attaching sample diffs in artifact link.

mike: Good call on tokenizer. Next step: run kernel microbench (attention-only) on A100/FP8 to see where generic_gemm is losing ops.

raj: I'll spin a small A100 test with new kernel flag later today. Keep this thread updated.

nina: thanks team. I'll post final numbers and the eval per-slice CSV when done.
